name: Caltrop Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

resistances.name: and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons

entries.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of combat, the golem has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While the caltrop golem is scattered, it is indistinguishable from a normal pile of caltrops.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Reform
entries: If the golem is scattered and has at least 1 hit point, it can reform as a bonus action in any space containing at least one of its caltrops without provoking an opportunity attack. If it reforms within 5 feet of a prone creature, it can make one slam attack against that creature as part of this bonus action.

entries.name: Scatter
entries: As a bonus action, the bearing golem can disperse, scattering its caltrops in a 15-foot cube, centered on the space it previously occupied. A creature moving through a space containing any of the golem's caltrops must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving this turn and take 1 piercing damage. Taking this damage reduces the creature's walking speed by 10 feet until the creature regains at least 1 hit point. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save. While scattered, the bearing golem can't attack or move, except to reform, and it can't be targeted by attacks or spells. It can still take damage from spells that deal damage in an area.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks. Alternatively, it uses its Steel Shot twice.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Steel Shot
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Scattershot
entries: The golem's body explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone. The golem immediately scatters.
